text:
devon: starting a bring-up for ceres-12B AWQ on CUDA24 + Triton + TensorRT-LLM. initial host is h100-prod-3. seeing large tail latencies and a small but consistent generation quality delta vs fp16 baseline. anyone seen similar? :thinking:

samir: saw something like this on a different model last month. can you paste a perf snippet and the quant config?

devon: perf snippet:
```
p95: 860ms
p50: 72ms
throughput: 18 seq/s
model: ceres-12b-awq-1.0
runtime: trtllm-v0.9
cuda: 24.1
```
quant config: `awq --bits 4 --group-size 128 --calib=kv`

anya: pinging infra-bot to check driver versions and recent deploys. :eyes:

infra-bot: deploy-notify: trtllm runtime v0.9 deployed to h100-prod-2..4 at 2234508000 by release-ci. kernel module nvidia 537.86.01.

lia: can you repro with vLLM fallback? trtllm sometimes introduces tiling that increases latency variance on long sequences. try `RUN_RUNTIME=vllm ./bench` to compare.

devon: ran vllm fallback, numbers below:
```
trtllm p95: 860ms
vllm  p95: 240ms
fp16 baseline p95: 210ms
```
quality check (perplexity-ish proxy) on eval set:
```
fp16: 1.00 (baseline)
awq-trtllm: 1.12
awq-vllm: 1.04
```
so trtllm+awq is worse both latency and quality.

samir: hmm that suggests trtllm path is hitting a numeric mismatch or fallback kernel that corrupts outputs. can you dump early token logits diff? also share `nvidia-smi -q` and container logs.

devon: attaching short diff (top-3 tokens) for step 12:
```
fp16: [the, of, and]
awq-vllm: [the, of, and] (match)
awq-trtllm: [then, of, and] (token 0 changed prob 0.45->0.32)
```
container logs show repeated warnings: `TRTLLM_WARN: kernel fallback: tiling mismatch for head 7` and a couple of `cuLaunchKernel` warnings.

anya: can someone check symbol versioning? last week we saw an ABI mismatch between trtllm plugin built against cuda 24.0 and driver 537.x causing weird kernels to run slower. infra-bot, any node-level anomalies?

infra-bot: h100-prod-3 dmesg: `nvidia: GPU lockup detected` at 2234509120, recovered. no ECC errors. kernel module loaded: 537.86.01. docker image trtllm:v0.9 built against cudatoolkit 24.0.

samir: that lockup is suspicious. might trigger slow-paths in runtime. can you repro on devbox with same driver but smaller batch? also try TRT builder flags: disable tiling fusion: `TRT_DISABLE_PLUGIN_TILING=1` and see if latency stabilizes.

devon: quick test with tiling disabled:
```
trtllm p95: 230ms
quality: awq-trtllm: 1.03
```
so disabling tiling fixes both perf and quality.

lia: ok that narrows it: tiling plugin has a correctness/perf regression with AWQ quant layouts under cuda24+driver 537.86.01. patch candidate: tighten tile alignment codepath for grouped-quant layouts. I'll open a PR.

bench-bot: perf summary uploaded: https://bench.internal/ceres12b/2234509999 (p95-before 860ms -> after toggle 230ms).

anya: great triage. action items: 1) lia to PR fix for tiling alignment + unit test on grouped quant, 2) infra to roll nodes to driver 536.x for immediate mitigation, 3) add safe-fallback knob `TRTLLM_DISABLE_TILING_FOR_QUANT=1` and enable in prod until verified. assign samir as oncall for any regressions.

samir: acked. I'll coordinate infra roll and watch error rates.

devon: thanks all — will keep running evals and post updated perf matrix. :thumbsup:
